notes:
A coalition assignment, not a quest: no Start field, and the walkthrough never names an NPC. The giver is the rendered ## Giver block that stage A resolved from the Scouts' Coalition page (front matter giver_source) -- Task Delegator, Eastern Adoulin (F-9), no giver_conflict -- and it carries both the accept and the report-back. Neither of those two rungs is written anywhere on this page, so both cite bullet 0 (the material above the walkthrough, the convention _run088 used) rather than being pinned to a walkthrough bullet about something else. Rank: Petitioner is a coalition rank, a real gate with no schema field, and it is NOT gates.level, which means character level -- recorded here and flagged rank_gate_unmodelled. The objective is satisfied at ANY ONE of four named Ergon Loci across TWO zones: Bud of the Swarm and Flourishing Island in Ceizak Battlegrounds, Luminous Isle and Immutable Boulder in Yahse Hunting Grounds. The assignment table's Zone field is Ceizak Battlegrounds, so that is the zone recorded and the Yahse branch is unmodelled. No grid: there are two loci in Ceizak and the page contradicts itself on both of their squares -- the Ergon Loci table puts Bud of the Swarm at I-8 while bullet 5's heading says I-7, and it puts Flourishing Island at J-10 while bullet 6's heading says K-10. The examine only registers at a distance that depends on Vana'diel game time (bullet 2's Time and Positioning table), which no packet reports, so nothing here is evidence. Bullet 3 is search strategy and bullets 4-8 are a crowd-sourced log of observed distances -- reference data, not steps. Luminous Isle additionally requires key item "Watercrafting", a per-alternative requirement that cannot be written as items on a step that also covers three loci which do not need it, hence items_partial on step 2. Target name is the generic entity the objective and the walkthrough both use, Ergon Locus; the four table rows are wiki labels for individual loci, and picking one of them would be choosing a branch the page leaves open.

notes: Coalition assignment, and a delivery rather than the usual gather-and-report: still three rungs, but the middle one hands a key item to a DIFFERENT NPC in the field instead of collecting something. Rank: Disciple is a coalition rank with no schema field and is NOT gates.level, which means character level; recorded in prose and flagged rank_gate_unmodelled. Bullet 1 grants [KI] Hen. FB op. materials container AT the accept, so under the rule that evidence must be obtained at its own step it is step 1's evidence, not step 2's -- holding it proves the accept is behind you. It is a key item, not an ordinary item: the Notes section after the walkthrough (its bullets restart at [1], so it is cited in prose rather than by number) quotes the failure message for turning it in 'with the key item broken'. Step 2 hands it to any Bivouac Administrator: four of them, at (G-6), (J-10), (H-9) and northwest (F-9), and bullet 2 says ANY one will do, so this is an OR across four squares, not a group, and no grid is recorded. The container is consumed on hand-in, so it cannot be evidence twice. Step 3 is the report-back, and unusually for this family the page attests it: bullet 3's last sub-bullet says to use the Waypoint to return to the Task Delegator in Western Adoulin for the reward. Bullet 3 as a whole is a Watercrafting shortcut route and is advice, not a step -- the record takes only the return-to-giver fact from it. The rest of bullet 1's sub-bullets (Waypoints are safe, cancelling refunds imprimaturs, Warp does not break the container) and the whole Notes section are warnings and outcomes, not rungs.
